name: Absorption scatter physical UI and Core locations after blocked first publication

condition.code: return JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI~=nil and not Controls.OpenButton:IsHidden() and ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer())~=nil

steps.code:
local panel=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI)
assert(panel.Open() and not Controls.Panel:IsHidden(),'human native scatter choice panel did not open')
local first=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer()))
assert(first.ID=='native-scatter-flow' and first.Phase=='CHOICE','wrong pending native scatter flow')
local sent={}
local function nextChoice()
 local flow=ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer())
 if not flow or flow.Phase~='CHOICE' then return end
 for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries or {}) do
  if not entry.EscapeOutcome and not entry.SelectedAction then
   if sent[entry.ID] then return end
   assert(panel.SelectEntry(entry.ID),'could not select '..entry.ID)
   local action=entry.Kind=='UNIT' and 'INCORPORATE'
     or entry.Kind=='PERSON' and 'RECRUIT'
     or entry.Kind=='HERO' and 'RECONTRACT'
     or entry.Kind=='GREAT_PERSON' and 'RECRUIT'
     or entry.Kind=='ITEM' and 'TRANSFER'
     or entry.Kind=='UNLOCK' and 'INHERIT' or 'PRESERVE'
   assert(panel.ChooseAction(action),'real UI rejected '..entry.ID..'/'..action)
   sent[entry.ID]=true
   return
  end
 end
end
Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Add(nextChoice)
nextChoice()
return 'human native scatter selections started through the real panel'

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local flow=assert(F.Get('native-scatter-flow'))
local baseline=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW'))
assert(flow.Phase=='CHOICE' and flow.Phase1Complete,'scatter choice phase changed before confirmation')
local n=0
for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries or {}) do
 if entry.ID=='native-work:'..baseline.WorkIndex then
  n=n+1
  assert(entry.EscapeOutcome=='SCATTER' and not entry.SelectedAction,'escaped original work was chosen again')
  assert(A.Rules.Equal(entry.Rolls,baseline.Rolls),'original work was rerolled')
 elseif not entry.EscapeOutcome then assert(entry.SelectedAction,'surviving asset lacks a UI choice') end
end
assert(n==1,'original work missing or duplicated in saved Flow')
assert(#A.NativeWorkLocations(baseline.WorkIndex)==1,'choice phase moved original work early')
return 'all surviving assets selected and scattered work roll unchanged'

local panel=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI)
local view=panel.GetView()
assert(view.phase=='CHOICE' and view.canResolve and not Controls.ConfirmButton:IsDisabled(),'scatter confirmation control not ready')
Controls.ConfirmButton:DoLeftClick()
return 'human clicked the real scatter Flow confirm control'

condition.code:
local id='native-scatter-flow'
local flow=ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow and ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.Get(id)
local state=ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption and ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption.GetState()
local tx=state and state.Transactions[id]
if not flow then return false end
if flow.Phase=='BLOCKED' or flow.Phase=='RESULT' then return true end
if not tx then return false end
if tx.NativeDealUI and tx.NativeDealUI.Index==2 then return true end
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Source.Index==2 and work.PhysicalMoved then return true end end
return false

steps.code:
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local flow=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow).Get('native-scatter-flow')
local state=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption).GetState()
local tx=state.Transactions['native-scatter-flow']
local source=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Work.X,plan.Work.Y)
local target=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y)
local sourceIndex=source and source:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(plan.Work.Building)
  and source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Work.Building,plan.Work.Slot) or -1
local targetIndex=target and target:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(plan.Building)
  and target:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot) or -1
local owners,seen={},{}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
if not seen[plan.Free] then owners[#owners+1]=plan.Free end
local found={}
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
 local player=Players[owner]
 if player then for _,city in player:GetCities():Members() do
  local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
  for def in GameInfo.Buildings() do
   if buildings:HasBuilding(def.Index) then
    for slot=0,buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(def.Index)-1 do
     if buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(def.Index,slot)==plan.WorkIndex then
      found[#found+1]={Owner=owner,City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=def.Index,Slot=slot}
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end end
end
ExposedMembers.JAC_ScatterPhysicalScanCount=(ExposedMembers.JAC_ScatterPhysicalScanCount or 0)+1
local result={Count=#found,Found=found,SourceIndex=sourceIndex,SourceOwner=source and source:GetOwner(),
 TargetIndex=targetIndex,TargetOwner=target and target:GetOwner(),FlowPhase=flow and flow.Phase,
 FlowError=flow and flow.Error,TxStatus=tx and tx.Status,DealSubmitted=tx and tx.NativeWorks and tx.NativeWorks[1] and tx.NativeWorks[1].DealSubmitted}
ExposedMembers.JAC_ScatterPhysicalSnapshot=result
print('[JAC_SCATTER_UI_PHYSICAL_'..ExposedMembers.JAC_ScatterPhysicalScanCount..'] '..assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption).Canonical(result))
return 'physical scan '..ExposedMembers.JAC_ScatterPhysicalScanCount..' found='..#found..' source='..tostring(sourceIndex)..' FreeCity='..tostring(targetIndex)

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local snap=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_ScatterPhysicalSnapshot)
assert(snap.Count==1 and snap.TargetIndex==plan.WorkIndex and snap.SourceIndex==-1,'original work is not uniquely held in the exact Free Cities Temple')
local work=snap.Found[1]
assert(work.Owner==plan.Free and work.City==plan.ID and work.X==plan.X and work.Y==plan.Y
 and work.Building==plan.Building and work.Slot==plan.Slot,'original work moved to another slot')
